NORTHFIELD MOTOR HOUSE - COLLECTION, DELIVERY AND HANDOVER OPERATIONS

This is a fictional operations guide used only in the LoomAI dealership demonstration.

Before collection, the customer receives an appointment and a final balance statement. The customer must bring photo identification, evidence of insurance effective from handover, and any agreed part-exchange keys and documents. Northfield releases the vehicle only after cleared funds and the identity check are complete.

The handover adviser checks the registration details, recorded mileage, agreed accessories, charging cable where applicable, keys, service history supplied with the vehicle, dashboard warning lights and visible condition with the customer. The customer receives a handover summary and contact route for aftercare.

Standard local delivery is available within 25 miles of Northfield Riverside for GBP 49. Delivery from 26 to 75 miles is quoted individually. Delivery beyond 75 miles is not offered by the demonstration policy. A delivery slot is confirmed only after cleared funds, identity verification, insurance evidence and a completed remote condition review.

If identity, payment or insurance evidence is incomplete, handover is paused rather than bypassed. The dealership team arranges a new slot after the missing requirement is resolved.
